## 2026 MLB Averages

```{r league-averages}
#| output: asis

hit_avgs <- dplyr::tibble(
  Stat  = c("AVG", "OBP", "SLG", "OPS", "wRC+", "ISO",
            "BB%", "K%", "BABIP", "EV (mph)", "Brl%"),
  Value = c(".244", ".313", ".399", ".712", "100", ".155",
            "8.5%", "22.6%", ".295", "88.5", "7.8%")
)

pitch_avgs <- dplyr::tibble(
  Stat  = c("ERA", "FIP", "xFIP", "WHIP", "K%", "BB%",
            "K-BB%", "ERA+", "GB%", "SwStr%"),
  Value = c("4.15", "4.10", "4.12", "1.27", "22.6%", "8.5%",
            "14.1%", "100", "43.2%", "11.2%")
)

cat('<div style="display:flex; gap:2rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:1.5rem;">\n')

cat('<div style="flex:1; min-width:240px;">\n')
hit_tbl <- hit_avgs %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(title = "Hitting Averages") %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size           = 13,
    heading.align             = "left",
    data_row.padding          = gt::px(4),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    table.width               = gt::pct(100)
  ) %>%
  gt::opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
cat(gt::as_raw_html(hit_tbl), "\n")
cat('</div>\n')

cat('<div style="flex:1; min-width:240px;">\n')
pitch_tbl <- pitch_avgs %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(title = "Pitching Averages") %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size           = 13,
    heading.align             = "left",
    data_row.padding          = gt::px(4),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    table.width               = gt::pct(100)
  ) %>%
  gt::opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
cat(gt::as_raw_html(pitch_tbl), "\n")
cat('</div>\n')

cat('</div>\n')
```

## Stat Definitions

```{r stat-defs}
#| output: asis

make_def_table <- function(data, title) {
  data %>%
    gt::gt() %>%
    gt::tab_header(title = title) %>%
    gt::cols_label(
      Stat     = "Stat",
      Full     = "Full Name",
      Measures = "What It Measures",
      Better   = gt::md("&#x2191; Better?")
    ) %>%
    gt::cols_width(
      Stat     ~ gt::px(90),
      Full     ~ gt::px(170),
      Better   ~ gt::px(70)
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style    = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a73e8"),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = "Stat")
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style    = list(gt::cell_fill(color = "#d4edda"),
                      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#155724")),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = "Better",
                                  rows = Better == "Yes")
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style    = list(gt::cell_fill(color = "#f8d7da"),
                      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#721c24")),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = "Better",
                                  rows = Better == "No")
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style    = gt::cell_fill(color = "#fff3cd"),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = "Better",
                                  rows = Better == "Context")
    ) %>%
    gt::fmt_missing(columns = dplyr::everything(), missing_text = "—") %>%
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.size           = 12,
      heading.align             = "left",
      data_row.padding          = gt::px(5),
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
      table.width               = gt::pct(100)
    ) %>%
    gt::opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
}

# ── Hitting definitions ──────────────────────────────────────
hitting_defs <- dplyr::tribble(
  ~Stat,      ~Full,                          ~Measures,                                                                                              ~Better,
  "AVG",      "Batting Average",              "Hits per at-bat. Simple but ignores walks and power.",                                                 "Yes",
  "OBP",      "On-Base Percentage",           "How often a batter reaches base (H + BB + HBP). Better measure of plate skill than AVG.",              "Yes",
  "SLG",      "Slugging Percentage",          "Total bases per at-bat. Rewards extra-base hits over singles.",                                         "Yes",
  "OPS",      "On-Base + Slugging",           "OBP + SLG combined. Quick proxy for overall offensive value.",                                          "Yes",
  "wRC+",     "Weighted Runs Created Plus",   "Runs created above average, park & league adjusted. 100 = league average. Best single offensive stat.", "Yes",
  "wOBA",     "Weighted On-Base Average",     "Weights each outcome (walk, single, HR) by actual run value. Correlates tightly with run scoring.",     "Yes",
  "xwOBA",    "Expected wOBA",                "wOBA based on exit velocity & launch angle, not actual outcomes. Strips luck from batted balls.",        "Yes",
  "ISO",      "Isolated Power",               "SLG minus AVG. Pure extra-base hit power — eliminates singles from the equation.",                      "Yes",
  "BABIP",    "Batting Avg on Balls in Play", "AVG on non-HR batted balls. League avg ~.295. High BABIP may signal luck or speed.",                    "Context",
  "BB%",      "Walk Rate",                    "Unintentional walks per plate appearance. Measures plate discipline and pitch recognition.",              "Yes",
  "K%",       "Strikeout Rate",               "Strikeouts per plate appearance. High K% limits offensive ceiling.",                                     "No",
  "Chase%",   "Chase Rate",                   "Swings on pitches outside the strike zone. Lower = better discipline.",                                  "No",
  "ZCon%",    "Zone Contact Rate",            "Contact rate on pitches in the zone. High = difficult to strike out on hittable pitches.",               "Yes",
  "SwStr%",   "Swinging Strike Rate",         "Swings and misses per pitch seen. Key bat-to-ball contact indicator.",                                   "No",
  "CSW%",     "Called Strike + Whiff %",      "Called strikes + swinging strikes per pitch. Measures how often a pitcher wins a pitch.",                "No",
  "F-Strike%","First-Strike %",               "How often the first pitch is a strike. High = better counts for pitchers.",                             "Context",
  "EV",       "Exit Velocity",                "Average speed off the bat (mph). Higher = harder contact, more run value.",                             "Yes",
  "HH%",      "Hard-Hit Rate",                "Batted balls at 95+ mph. Statcast's hard contact threshold.",                                           "Yes",
  "Brl%",     "Barrel Rate",                  "Batted balls with EV/launch angle combo yielding .500+ AVG and 1.500+ SLG. Best quality-of-contact stat.", "Yes",
  "GB%",      "Ground Ball Rate",             "Batted balls hit on the ground. High GB% limits HR but can increase BABIP.",                            "Context",
  "LD%",      "Line Drive Rate",              "Line drives as % of batted balls. Highest BABIP rate of any batted ball type.",                          "Context",
  "FB%",      "Fly Ball Rate",                "Fly balls as % of batted balls. More fly balls = more HR chances.",                                      "Context",
  "HR/FB",    "HR per Fly Ball",              "Home runs as % of fly balls. Measures power on contact.",                                               "Yes",
  "Pull%",    "Pull Rate",                    "Batted balls hit to pull side. High pull% often correlates with power.",                                 "Context",
  "Sprint",   "Sprint Speed (mph)",           "Statcast feet-per-second converted to mph. Elite threshold: 30 ft/s (~20.5 mph in Statcast units).",    "Yes"
)

cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_def_table(hitting_defs, "Hitting & Plate Discipline — Definitions")), "\n\n")

# ── Pitching definitions ─────────────────────────────────────
pitching_defs <- dplyr::tribble(
  ~Stat,      ~Full,                          ~Measures,                                                                                              ~Better,
  "ERA",      "Earned Run Average",           "Earned runs per 9 innings. Simple, widely cited, but influenced by defense and luck.",                  "No",
  "ERA+",     "Adjusted ERA+",                "ERA scaled to league/park, inverted so 100 = average. 120 = 20% better than average.",                  "Yes",
  "FIP",      "Fielding Independent Pitching","ERA estimator using only K, BB, HBP, HR — removes defense. Better predictor than ERA.",                 "No",
  "xFIP",     "Expected FIP",                 "FIP with HR/FB regressed to league average. Removes HR luck.",                                           "No",
  "xERA",     "Expected ERA (Statcast)",      "ERA estimate from Statcast expected stats (xwOBA) allowed. Best contact-quality predictor.",             "No",
  "SIERA",    "Skill-Interactive ERA",        "ERA estimator that accounts for GB/FB/K interaction. Considered most predictive ERA estimator.",         "No",
  "WHIP",     "Walks + Hits per Inning",      "Base runners allowed per inning. Quick measure of control + contact allowed.",                           "No",
  "K%",       "Strikeout Rate",               "Batters struck out per batter faced. Higher = more dominant stuff.",                                     "Yes",
  "BB%",      "Walk Rate",                    "Unintentional walks per batter faced. Lower = better command.",                                          "No",
  "K-BB%",    "K minus BB Rate",              "Strikeout rate minus walk rate. Best single command/stuff combined metric.",                             "Yes",
  "SwStr%",   "Swinging Strike Rate",         "Swinging strikes per pitch. Best in-game stuff indicator.",                                             "Yes",
  "CSW%",     "Called Strike + Whiff %",      "Called strikes + swinging strikes per pitch. Measures pitch effectiveness.",                             "Yes",
  "Chase%",   "Batter Chase Rate",            "How often batters swing at pitches outside the zone against this pitcher.",                              "Yes",
  "Zone%",    "Zone Rate",                    "Pitches thrown in the strike zone. Too low = walks, too high = hittable.",                               "Context",
  "GB%",      "Ground Ball Rate",             "Ground balls as % of batted balls allowed. High GB% suppresses HR.",                                     "Yes",
  "BABIP",    "BABIP Against",                "AVG on balls in play against pitcher. Near .295 = expected, far off = luck.",                            "Context",
  "LOB%",     "Left on Base %",               "Runners left on base. High LOB% (80%+) often means luck is involved — expect regression.",              "Context",
  "Avg EV",   "Avg Exit Velocity Against",    "Average speed off bat against this pitcher. Lower = generating weak contact.",                           "No",
  "Brl%",     "Barrel Rate Against",          "Barrels allowed as % of batted balls. Best contact-quality-against metric.",                             "No",
  "xwOBA",    "xwOBA Against",                "Expected wOBA based on contact quality allowed. Best Statcast pitching metric.",                          "No",
  "fWAR",     "FanGraphs WAR",                "Wins Above Replacement using FIP-based pitching value. Season totals: 2 = solid starter, 5+ = ace.",    "Yes"
)

cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_def_table(pitching_defs, "Pitching — Definitions")), "\n\n")

# ── Baserunning & Defense definitions ────────────────────────
other_defs <- dplyr::tribble(
  ~Stat,      ~Full,                          ~Measures,                                                                                              ~Better,
  "Spd",      "Speed Score (Bill James)",     "Composite speed metric from SB%, runs scored, triples, and position. Scale 0-10.",                     "Yes",
  "UBR",      "Ultimate Base Running",        "Runs above average on non-SB baserunning (taking extra bases, avoiding outs on bases).",                "Yes",
  "BsR",      "Base Running Runs",            "Total baserunning value: UBR + wSB combined. Overall baserunning contribution in runs.",                "Yes",
  "wSB",      "Weighted Stolen Base Runs",    "Stolen base value in runs, accounting for both successful steals and caught stealing.",                  "Yes",
  "OAA",      "Outs Above Average",           "Statcast defensive metric — outs made vs. expected based on catch difficulty. 0 = average.",           "Yes",
  "DRS",      "Defensive Runs Saved",         "Runs saved above average on defense (Sports Info Solutions). 0 = average, +10 = Gold Glove level.",     "Yes",
  "UZR",      "Ultimate Zone Rating",         "Runs above average on defense using batted ball location. Multi-year samples most reliable.",            "Yes",
  "fWAR",     "FanGraphs WAR (Position)",     "Wins Above Replacement: batting + baserunning + defense + positional adjustment. 2 = solid, 5 = MVP.",  "Yes",
  "bWAR",     "Baseball-Reference WAR",       "Similar to fWAR but uses RA9 (runs allowed) for pitching and slightly different defense methodology.",   "Yes"
)

cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_def_table(other_defs, "Baserunning, Defense & WAR — Definitions")), "\n\n")
```

## Hitting Grades

```{r hitting-grades}
hitting_grades <- dplyr::tibble(
  Stat        = c("wRC+", "ISO", "OBP", "BB%", "K%", "BABIP", "EV (mph)", "Brl%", "Sprint (mph)"),
  Poor        = c("<70",    "<.080",  "<.290",  "<5%",   "25%+",  "<.260",  "<86",   "<2%",   "<23"),
  `Below Avg` = c("70-84",  ".080-.119", ".290-.319", "5-7%",  "22-25%", ".260-.279", "86-87.9", "2-4%",  "23-25.9"),
  Average     = c("85-100", ".120-.149", ".320-.339", "7-9%",  "18-22%", ".280-.300", "88-89.9", "4-6%",  "26-27.9"),
  `Above Avg` = c("101-115",".150-.189", ".340-.359", "9-11%", "14-18%", ".301-.320", "90-91.9", "6-9%",  "28-29.9"),
  Great       = c("116-130",".190-.229", ".360-.379", "11-13%","10-14%", ".321-.340", "92-93.9", "9-12%", "30-30.9"),
  Elite       = c("131+",   ".230+",     ".380+",     "13%+",  "<10%",   ".341+",     "94+",     "12%+",  "31+")
)

hitting_grades %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title    = "Hitting Stat Grade Ranges",
    subtitle = "Higher is better for all stats except K% (lower = better)"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    gt::md("2026 MLB context \u00b7 wRC+ and ERA+ are league-normalized to 100")
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Poor"),
    palette = "#f8d7da",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Below Avg"),
    palette = "#fde8d0",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Average"),
    palette = "#fff3cd",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Above Avg"),
    palette = "#d4f0d4",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Great"),
    palette = "#a8dba8",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Elite"),
    palette = "#5cb85c",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = "Elite")
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size           = 13,
    heading.align             = "left",
    data_row.padding          = gt::px(5),
    table.width               = gt::pct(100)
  ) %>%
  gt::opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
```

## Pitching Grades

```{r pitching-grades}
pitching_grades <- dplyr::tibble(
  Stat        = c("ERA", "FIP / xFIP", "ERA+", "WHIP", "K%", "BB%", "SwStr%", "GB%", "fWAR/season"),
  Elite       = c("<2.50",   "<2.80",   "150+",   "<0.95",  "30%+",  "<4%",   "16%+",  "55%+",  "5+"),
  Great       = c("2.50-3.24","2.80-3.29","130-149","0.95-1.09","26-30%","4-5.5%","14-16%","50-55%","3-5"),
  `Above Avg` = c("3.25-3.74","3.30-3.74","115-129","1.10-1.19","22-26%","5.5-7%","12-14%","45-50%","2-3"),
  Average     = c("3.75-4.24","3.75-4.24","95-114", "1.20-1.34","18-22%","7-9%",  "9-12%", "40-45%","1-2"),
  `Below Avg` = c("4.25-5.00","4.25-4.99","80-94",  "1.35-1.49","14-18%","9-11%", "7-9%",  "35-40%","0-1"),
  Poor        = c("5.00+",   "5.00+",   "<80",    "1.50+",  "<14%",  "11%+",  "<7%",   "<35%",  "<0")
)

pitching_grades %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title    = "Pitching Stat Grade Ranges",
    subtitle = "Lower is better for ERA, FIP, WHIP, BB% — higher is better for K%, SwStr%, GB%, fWAR"

    gt::md("2026 MLB context \u00b7 wRC+ and ERA+ are league-normalized to 100")

    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Above Avg"),
    palette = "#d4f0d4",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Average"),
    palette = "#fff3cd",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Below Avg"),
    palette = "#fde8d0",
    na_color = "white"
  ) %>%
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c("Poor"),
    palette = "#f8d7da",
    na_color = "white"

    style = gt::cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"),

    data_row.padding          = gt::px(5),
    table.width               = gt::pct(100)
  ) %>%
  gt::opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
```
